status: Publication admission and strict readback pass local checks; manager activation and retention remain incomplete

checks.command: KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS=<Kubernetes 1.37.0 darwin/arm64 assets> PTAH_REQUIRE_ENVTEST=1 GOFLAGS=-p=1 go test -count=1 -json ./test/envtest/resultstore ./test/envtest/webhook

proved: Only the configured manager can create publication records through the chart webhook. Each create requires the canonical issued credential, its exact binding, and current operation/Job/Pod authority. All nine operation credential fixtures authorize their own publication bindings.

Intent geometry and canonical bytes, chunk names/lengths/digests and intent owner UID, and completion manifest/chunk UIDs and full payload digest are validated. Completion additionally validates the runner protocol and engine under canonical authority.
Durable readback shares strict canonical manifest and metadata validation; unsupported metadata and malformed or damaged records do not yield partial payloads.

Real API publication of a Resolve refusal result succeeds through installed guards and reads back the same bytes. Unissued authority, retirement before completion, and invalid runner protocol leave no completion or receipt.

Identical retry and lost API responses after intent, chunk, or completion resume through real admission. Concurrent identical publications converge in unit tests; completion visibility between admission and CREATE is not mistaken for repair.

Publication metadata UPDATE, DELETE, and DeleteCollection are refused through the real webhook. Deletion remains refused after SQL authority is retired. Removing/restoring the webhook demonstrates its deletion refusal.
A missing intent or chunk of an already completed publication cannot be recreated through admission.
notProved: Installed manager receiver activation, chart permissions, controller durable-result consumption, or default-log maximum-plan workflow.

The real webhook publication fixture uses a small Resolve refusal payload, not a maximum-size Plan or database execution. Separate resultstore tests exercise the full storage payload bound without publication admission.
Publication deletion is intentionally refused pending retention and consumption integration; this checkpoint does not complete garbage collection, quota, backup/restore, or uninstall.
Admission handlers use an administrator reader in envtest; this does not prove installed least-privilege admission permissions.
Live authority checks and record creation are not atomic across Kubernetes objects. Receiver and consumer validation remain necessary.
Complete supported environment matrix, production acceptance, all issue 586 DoDs, or full make verify on this commit.
